svg.text: CampusOne · implemented SQLite tables, physical foreign keys, and JSON/application references
13 content tables share: id (PK), data (valid JSON), created_at, updated_at. Key payload fields are shown below.
JSON references are enforced by server logic; they are not SQL foreign keys.
HOW TO READ THIS IMPLEMENTED SCHEMA
Only the four SQL foreign keys declared in SQLite.
Thirteen tables store id, JSON data and timestamps.
Courses, resources and assignedClasses are JSON arrays.
Faculty directory entries are not linked to Users.
registrations is authoritative for new registrations.
linkTarget is route metadata, not a relationship.
Subjects, semesters and timetables are not separate tables.
users.email is unique case-insensitively; registrations(eventId,userId) and bookmarks(userId,itemType,itemId) have unique indexes.
Department courses/resources and user assignedClasses are JSON arrays, not tables. Notification linkTarget is route metadata, not an FK.
Faculty directory records are separate from USERS. Facilities are campus-wide. Payload references are enforced by application logic only.
Source: server/src/db.ts and src/types/index.ts. This figure reflects the current implementation; it is not a normalized future schema.
